body:
Picked: B) 5-step lesson.

IEVA (by the stable, grooms horses)
First time: "Hi! I'm Ieva. These horses are my best friends." → "Want a ride? First a lesson. Stan is at the jump field!" (Stan gets a ⭐ on the map.)
Before the lesson, again: "Stan is waiting at the jump field!"
After the lesson: "Stan says you did great! Pick a horse." → "Bring her back to the stable when you're done."
All horses out: "Every horse is out. Come back soon!"
With pets: "Your pets can wait here with me."
Bringing a horse back: "Thank you! She had fun."
Foal: "She's too little to ride. You can pet her!"
Random (never the same twice in a row): "Brushing makes their coat shine." / "Clover loves apples." / "The trail goes all around the farm."

STAN (jump field, lesson horse)
Start: "Howdy! I'm Stan. Ready for your first lesson?" (Yes / Later)
Steps, one short line each:
1. "Tap the horse to get on."
2. "Walk to the blue flag."
3. "Now trot to the red flag!"
4. "Now jump that one!" (the lowest jump of the existing course, course:x/v/o/s; no new log)
5. "Stop by me. Easy does it."
End: "You're a natural! Ieva will lend you a horse anytime." 🎉
After: "Practise jumps here any time!"

HORSE (near town, it stops)
"Your horse won't go closer to town." (shown once per ride)

Rules used: rules-* riding (lesson first, 10 shared horses, one rider each, back to stable, stops near town, foals can't be ridden, pets wait at the stable).
